_note: List prices in USD per million tokens, used by scripts/pipeline/runner.py for the cost cap and the estimate before a run. The cap uses these prices and the usage the provider reports; it is not the provider's invoice. Batch = the provider's batch discount applied to every price of the row. Where a price is not published or not verified, the row uses the higher price that is known, so that the cap errs on the side of stopping early.

claude-opus-5-5.source: Anthropic model and pricing documentation (claude-api reference, read 23 Nov 2026)

deepseek-v4-pro.source: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing (read 23 Nov 2026): peak prices (cache hit 0.044, cache miss 1.32, output 3.96 USD per 1M; model DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813). Off-peak is half of peak; peak hours are 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri. The row keeps the peak price so that the cap errs on the side of stopping early. No batch interface.
